host.title: Hostname
host.description: The fully qualified domain name used to access Vaultwarden (e.g. password.freepod.eu)

allowed.title: Allow open registration
allowed.description: Allow anyone who knows the address to create an account. Leave off unless you need it: your own account is created for you, and you can invite others from the web vault.

verify.title: Require email verification on signups
verify.description: New users must confirm their email address before they can log in.
